title: Potential of quercitrin in psoriasis intervention: Dual regulation of the oxidative stress-NF-kappaB axis and gut microbiota homeostasis.
authors: Guo, Danyue; Wang, Rongrong; Liu, Shuyu; Liu, Weihua; Wang, Xianghong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究槲皮苷通过NF-κB通路和肠道菌群治疗银屑病，分子对接仅涉及蛋白-小分子（TLR4/MyD88），无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Psoriasis, a chronic inflammatory skin disease, imposes a substantial clinical burden with limited long-term treatment efficacy. Quercitrin (QUE), a natural flavonoid possessing anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, exhibits therapeutic potential for psoriasis, yet its precise mechanism of action remains to be fully elucidated. METHODS: To evaluate the effects of QUE, LPS-stimulated HaCaT cells (modeling keratinocyte immune activation) and IMQ-induced psoriatic mice were employed. Skin pathology was assessed by PASI score and histopathological staining. Inflammatory cytokines and oxidative stress markers were measured both in vitro and in vivo using ELISA and commercial kits. NF-kappaB pathway expression was analyzed by Western blot (in vitro), IHC, and RT-qPCR (in vivo). Molecular docking predicted the binding of QUE to TLR4/MyD88, and 16S rRNA sequencing was used to analyze changes in gut microbiota composition. RESULTS: QUE effectively inhibited LPS-induced NF-kappaB activation and oxidative stress in HaCaT cells, leading to reduced release of pro-inflammatory cytokines. In IMQ-induced psoriatic mice, QUE treatment not only alleviated skin lesions and reduced splenomegaly, but also restored the structural integrity of dermal collagen and elastic fibers, thereby improving skin barrier function. Furthermore, QUE suppressed cutaneous NF-kappaB activation while ameliorating both systemic and local oxidative stress. Molecular docking analysis revealed that QUE directly binds to TLR4 and MyD88. Additionally, QUE restored gut microbiota homeostasis and enhanced intestinal barrier integrity. CONCLUSIONS: QUE alleviates psoriatic inflammation through synergistic regulation of the NF-kappaB pathway and gut microbiota homeostasis, exhibiting potential as a multi-target therapeutic agent.
abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病是一种慢性炎症性皮肤病，给临床带来沉重负担，且长期治疗效果有限。槲皮苷（QUE）是一种具有抗炎和抗氧化特性的天然黄酮类化合物，对银屑病显示出治疗潜力，但其确切作用机制仍有待全面阐明。方法：为评估QUE的效果，采用脂多糖（LPS）刺激的HaCaT细胞（模拟角质形成细胞免疫激活）和咪喹莫特（IMQ）诱导的银屑病小鼠模型。通过PASI评分和组织病理学染色评估皮肤病理变化。使用ELISA和商业试剂盒在体外和体内测量炎症细胞因子和氧化应激标志物。通过Western blot（体外）、IHC和RT-qPCR（体内）分析NF-kappaB通路表达。分子对接预测QUE与TLR4/MyD88的结合，并使用16S rRNA测序分析肠道微生物群组成的变化。结果：QUE有效抑制LPS诱导的HaCaT细胞中NF-kappaB激活和氧化应激，从而减少促炎细胞因子的释放。在IMQ诱导的银屑病小鼠中，QUE治疗不仅减轻了皮肤病变和脾肿大，还恢复了真皮胶原蛋白和弹性纤维的结构完整性，从而改善了皮肤屏障功能。此外，QUE抑制了皮肤NF-kappaB激活，同时改善了全身和局部氧化应激。分子对接分析显示QUE直接与TLR4和MyD88结合。另外，QUE恢复了肠道微生物群稳态并增强了肠道屏障完整性。结论：QUE通过协同调节NF-kappaB通路和肠道微生物群稳态来缓解银屑病炎症，展现出作为多靶点治疗药物的潜力。
